wizard.title: Add zone
wizard.s1_text: Choose the sensor that sees the spot where the zone will be.
wizard.no_sensor: There is no FP300 or FP400 yet. Add a sensor via Add device first, then come back.
wizard.s2_text: Swipe over the blocks where the zone should be. Swipe over painted blocks to remove them again. Each block is 50 by 50 cm.
wizard.live_off: Move a little to see yourself
wizard.existing: Or pick a zone that is already drawn:
wizard.s3_text: You will see this name in Homey and in your flows.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.suggestions: Sofa, Desk, Bed, Dining table, Kitchen, Door
wizard.empty_hint: How long the zone stays occupied after someone stepped out. Short reacts fast, longer prevents flicker.
wizard.s4_text: After adding you can put the device in any Homey room.
wizard.custom_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 300.
wizard.live_fp300: Person at __distance__ m, measured __age__ s ago
wizard.live_fp300_far: Present, no distance within 6 m yet. Briefly press the sensor button if needed.
wizard.live_fp300_off: Nobody seen. Walk in front of the sensor.
wizard.s2_text_fp300: Stand where the zone should be: your block lights up. Tap or swipe over the zone's blocks. Each block is 25 cm.
wizard.live_fp300_waiting: Measurement requested, the sensor is still asleep. Briefly press the button of this sensor.
wizard.live_fp300_pir: This sensor is set to "PIR only". Set Detection with to mmWave in its settings, otherwise there is no distance.

editor.title: Zones
editor.intro: Adjust your zones, or paint ignore spots and what lies outside the room.
editor.no_sensor: No FP300 or FP400 has been added yet.
editor.no_zones: No zones yet. Create a zone via Add device, Aqara FP Zones, Zone (FP300 / FP400).
editor.live_off: Move a little to see yourself
editor.name: Name
editor.add_hint: Create a new zone via Add device, Aqara FP Zones, Zone (FP300 / FP400). Want a zone gone completely? Remove the zone device in Homey.
editor.linked_hint: Belongs to the device "__name__". To remove this zone, remove that device in Homey; the zone goes with it.
editor.pick: Pick a zone above to adjust it
editor.need_cells: Paint at least one block first.
editor.hint_zones: Pick a zone to change its shape, name or timing. Tap a dot where nobody is standing to make the sensor forget it.
editor.hint_ignore: Paint spots where ghost dots appear, such as near a fan, curtain or TV. The sensor ignores movement there and zones do not count it.
editor.hint_outside: Paint everything outside the room, such as behind a wall or window. The sensor does not look there and zones do not count it.
editor.target_text: Nobody here? Make the sensor forget this dot. A real person shows up again within seconds. If the dot keeps coming back, turn the spot into an ignore spot.
editor.area_unsaved: Not saved yet. This is stored in the sensor itself, like the Aqara app does.
editor.area_saved: This is what the sensor has stored. Swipe over the map to change it.
editor.toast_ignore_added: Ignore spot added, tap Save to sensor
editor.loose_hint: This zone has no device yet. Add it via Add device, Zone (FP300 / FP400), or remove it here.
editor.theme_hint: Automatic follows Homey. If that looks wrong, pick one yourself. Also used when adding zones.
editor.custom_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 300.
editor.live_fp300: Person at __distance__ m, measured __age__ s ago
editor.live_fp300_far: Present, no distance within 6 m yet. Briefly press the sensor button if needed.
editor.live_fp300_off: Nobody seen. Walk in front of the sensor.
editor.live_fp300_waiting: Measurement requested, the sensor is still asleep. Briefly press the button of this sensor.
editor.live_fp300_pir: This sensor is set to "PIR only". Set Detection with to mmWave in its settings, otherwise there is no distance.
editor.hint_range: Where the sensor itself detects presence. Walk through the room: the block you stand in lights up. Paint the blocks where it should see you and save. After that the sensor works on its own presence, without continuous distance measurement.

fp300.not_applied: __name__: the sensor did not take the setting __setting__. Try again and briefly press the sensor button.
fp300.applied: __name__: the new settings were applied to the sensor at __time__.
fp300.restart_done: __name__: the sensor restarted and checked in again at __time__.

fp400.learning_started: __name__: AI spatial learning started. Please stay out of the room.
fp400.learning_done: __name__: AI spatial learning finished, you can enter the room again.
fp400.learning_failed: __name__: AI spatial learning returned result code __code__. Try again with an empty room.

wake.learning: The app is still learning how often this sensor wakes up. Briefly press the sensor button to apply it right away.
wake.eta: This sensor usually checks in every __every__. Expected around __next__ (in __in__). Briefly press the button to apply it right away.
wake.warning: Waiting for the sensor to apply the change. __eta__

learning.started: __name__: AI spatial learning started. Stay out of the room until about __until__.
learning.busy: AI spatial learning in progress. Stay out of the room until about __until__.
learning.busy_fp400: AI spatial learning in progress. Stay out of the room; you get a message when the sensor is done.
learning.done_fp300: __name__: AI spatial learning finished, you can enter the room again. The FP300 does not report when it is done; the app waits the 10 minutes Aqara advises.
learning.done_with_movement: __name__: the learning time is over, but movement was seen while learning. Start learning again in an empty room for the best result.
learning.movement: __name__: movement was seen during AI spatial learning. This can affect the result; stay out of the room.
learning.no_result: __name__: the sensor sent no learning result within 15 minutes. Try AI spatial learning again.
learning.done_fp300_signal: __name__: the sensor reports that AI spatial learning is finished. You can enter the room again.
learning.label_movement: __bar__  Done at __time__, but there was movement while learning. Start again in an empty room.
learning.label_started_time: __bar__  Started at __time__, done around __until__. Stay out of the room.
learning.label_done_time: __bar__  Done at __time__ (after the 10 minutes Aqara advises). You can enter the room again.
learning.label_done_signal: __bar__  Done at __time__, reported by the sensor. You can enter the room again.
learning.live_confirmed: Start confirmed by the sensor at __time__.
learning.live_unconfirmed: Waiting for the sensor to confirm.
learning.live_movement: Movement seen at __time__, stay out of the room.
learning.live_none: No message from the sensor yet.

reset.done_sensor: __name__: default settings restored. The sensor reset its factory settings; the app is reading them now.
reset.done_fallback: __name__: default settings restored. This sensor has no Zigbee reset, so the app set standard detection values (as soon as the sensor is awake).
reset.unsupported_fp400: __name__: the app settings are restored, but the sensor does not support the Zigbee factory reset. The settings in the sensor are unchanged.
